At the other end, Spain nearly doubled their advantage as Ferran Torres rattled the crossbar from close range following a setup by Fabián Ruiz . As the clock ticked deep into stoppage time, tensions boiled over for the Celeste. After a series of yellow cards for late challenges, Agustín Canobbio was shown a straight red card in the 90+5th minute. The numerical disadvantage ended any hopes of a late Uruguayan comeback, allowing Spain to secure a hard-fought victory in a match defined by narrow margins and a dramatic conclusion.
